local p = {}

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local util_vars = require('Module:VarsUtil')
local lang = mw.getContentLanguage()
local OFFSETS = {asia = ' +08:00', ameu = ' -05:00'}
local PHASES = {'start', 'end'}

function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame)
	for server, default_offset in pairs(OFFSETS) do
		for i, phase in ipairs(PHASES) do
			local key = server .. ' ' .. phase
			local timestamp = args[key] or args[phase]

			if timestamp then
				local synced = args[phase .. ' synced'] and not args[key]
				local offset = synced and OFFSETS.asia or default_offset
				timestamp = lang:formatDate('c', timestamp .. offset)
			end
			util_vars.setVar(key, timestamp)
		end
	end
end

return p
